{{Top|leg}}
'''Com-band Gamma-34''' was a communications channel used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mal Biron]] while auditioning [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for potential work. Upon reaching the [[Novolek Beacon/Legends|Novolek Beacon]], instructions about the next stage of their job was transmitted from a [[communications satellite]] on com-band Gamma-34.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
